launch-email.notes: R and T both deliver a well-structured email with subject options, scannable benefits, one CTA and clear placeholders; R edges ahead by explicitly warning against promising unshipped features, while T presents more specific invented capabilities (tax extraction, learning categorization, team dashboards) as real. S is concise and invents nothing but is generic, lacks a real button/link CTA, and offers thin value to the reader.

yoga-landing.notes: R is the most complete and polished (philosophy, classes, tabbed schedule with ARIA, teachers, pricing, testimonials, validated signup, skip link, mobile menu), with minor flaws like JS-dependent reveal/schedule content and a success message claiming an email was sent. S is clean, attractive and accessible with dark mode and reduced-motion support, while T has strong mobile-first accessibility but a visually plain, imageless hero and a closing note referencing a section order the user never gave.

summary.notes: R is faithful, leads with the decision, covers every result, problem and ask in exactly 5 bullets, and its derived 85% figure checks out. T is equally faithful and complete but awkwardly bundles the Pune delay into the decision bullet, while S omits the complaints improvement and sorter replacement and is less well grouped.
